global_definition_of_done.description: The project brief and case-specific Definition of Done are frozen before the formal run.
The formal run preserves workflow checkpoints, approved artifacts, deterministic evidence, and final export references.
Requirement, acceptance-criterion, gate, artifact, test, traceability, repair, duration, and model-usage metrics are computable from preserved evidence.
Synthetic User Twin findings remain explicitly distinct from independent human evidence.
Base-versus-adapter expert packages are blinded and the identity key is stored separately from the review package.
Every reported result identifies the platform, execution profile, or model component to which it applies and records its limitation.
